SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( COALESCE(personal_scores.total_score, 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.personal_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) + COALESCE(team_scores.total_score, 0) * (COALESCE(weight_config.team_weight_rate, 50) / 100.0) ), 0 ) AS compositeScore FROM (SELECT #{employeeId} AS employee_id) base LEFT JOIN performance_weight weight_config ON weight_config.org_id = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.employee_id, SUM( LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p.difficulty_score, 0), 0), 10) * CASE WHEN p.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 1.0 WHEN p.end_date < p.expected_end_date THEN 1.1 WHEN p.end_date = p.expected_end_date THEN 1.0 ELSE GREATEST(0, 1.0 - (DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) * 0.05)) END * (COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) / 25.0) ) AS total_score FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.work_item = 'PERSONAL' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(p.end_date) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(p.end_date) = #{targetMonth} GROUP BY p.employee_id ) personal_scores ON personal_scores.employee_id = base.employee_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.employee_id, SUM( LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p.difficulty_score, 0), 0), 10) * CASE WHEN p.expected_end_date IS NULL THEN 1.0 WHEN p.end_date < p.expected_end_date THEN 1.1 WHEN p.end_date = p.expected_end_date THEN 1.0 ELSE GREATEST(0, 1.0 - (DATEDIFF(p.end_date, p.expected_end_date) * 0.05)) END * (COALESCE(p.achievement_rate, 0) / 25.0) ) AS total_score FROM performance p WHERE p.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND p.work_item = 'TEAM' AND p.status = 'ENDED' AND p.end_date IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(p.end_date) = #{targetYear} AND MONTH(p.end_date) = #{targetMonth} GROUP BY p.employee_id ) team_scores ON team_scores.employee_id = base.employee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO performance_metric_summary( employee_id, metric_year, metric_month, personal_kpi_achievement_rate, team_kpi_achievement_rate, monthly_core_goal_progress_rate, score_change_rate, composite_score, calculated_at ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{targetYear}, #{targetMonth}, #{personalKpiAchievementRate}, #{teamKpiAchievementRate}, #{monthlyCoreGoalProgressRate}, #{scoreChangeRate}, #{compositeScore}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE personal_kpi_achievement_rate = VALUES(personal_kpi_achievement_rate), team_kpi_achievement_rate = VALUES(team_kpi_achievement_rate), monthly_core_goal_progress_rate = VALUES(monthly_core_goal_progress_rate), score_change_rate = VALUES(score_change_rate), composite_score = VALUES(composite_score), calculated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, metric_year AS metricYear, metric_month AS metricMonth, personal_kpi_achievement_rate AS personalKpiAchievementRate, team_kpi_achievement_rate AS teamKpiAchievementRate, monthly_core_goal_progress_rate AS monthlyCoreGoalProgressRate, score_change_rate AS scoreChangeRate, composite_score AS compositeScore, calculated_at AS calculatedAt FROM performance_metric_summary WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND metric_year = #{targetYear} AND metric_month = #{targetMonth}

SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, metric_year AS metricYear, metric_month AS metricMonth, personal_kpi_achievement_rate AS personalKpiAchievementRate, team_kpi_achievement_rate AS teamKpiAchievementRate, monthly_core_goal_progress_rate AS monthlyCoreGoalProgressRate, score_change_rate AS scoreChangeRate, composite_score AS compositeScore, calculated_at AS calculatedAt FROM performance_metric_summary WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY metric_year DESC, metric_month DESC LIMIT 1
